title: Fantastic but no Apple Watch functionality
body:
The app is fantastic. A very good take on the pomodoro technique. The option to listen to different sounds is a nice touch. And the gamification mechanism to unlock new trees is effective.

However it’s a shame that there is no way to start the timer on the Apple Watch. Which is weird because the app is essentially a timer. Setting the timer on your watch would make you less prone to be distracted by your phone when you pick it up. 

You can view your forest on the watch, which is nice.

If you can’t stay your way from your phone. This may help you to focus. You can see your little plant or tree slowly grow and as the timer goes down. You can use for anything else until it’s grown or you kill your plant. For me it’s just that little extra I needed. If I don’t want to kill my plant, I don’t use my phone until it’s grown. You can see the Forrest you’ve planted (=time spend while not distracted by your phone). It’s rewarding to see and on top of that you get coins to buy other plant so after a while you could have a digital Forrest with lots of variatie. Fun to see 😄
Oh and they have a project where they plant real trees too. 
Only benefits so far.

title: Une application indispensable!
body: Une application simple mais incroyable pour nous forcer à travailler! Elle m'aide au quotidien, je ne peux plus m'en passer! Elle a un concept nouveau, amusant et utile. Une appli que j'ai cherché pendant longtemps, aucune autre ne peut selon moi l'égaler! Elle correspond exactement à mes besoins et à ceux de personnes qui ont du mal à se concentrer sur autre chose que leur téléphone. Elle donne même envie de travailler grâce à son graphisme et ses arbres funs. Une appli également qui a du coeur et qui est engagée auprès d'une association afin de planter des arbres dans la vie réelle! Pour moi, elle vaut vraiment son prix et est indispensable! C'est l'une des rares applications que j'ai acheté et je ne le regrette pas du tout! Juste incroyable! Elle change un quotidien et rend les tâches pénibles, plus agréables et amusantes. Peu connue en Belgique pour l'instant, mais je suis sûre qu'elle pourrait l’être plus avec un peu de pub.. Elle connaîtra un grand succès c'est certain!

title: Combine OCD with productivity
body:
This probably saved my exams. Once started, I get a splash of OCD, and don’t want to kill my tree. Wish there were some more of those hilarious / encouraging words, like “Are you sure you want to kill your cute, little tree?” I’d really recommend this app to anyone. 
Just a few recommendations / things why I didn’t go for the five stars:
- there’s a bit of an issue that makes the store inaccessible (keeps loading and then crashes)
- it would be nice to see your tree fluently grow, instead of having it grow in 4 steps
- when you exceed your focused time, the tree doesn’t grow to the next stage, the ‘basic’ version stays
- I’d very much like an improved cooperation between the app on my phone and on my computer. When I’m working on my laptop, I plant a tree in my browser (love the black- and whitelist sites), but nothing stops me from getting on my phone. And I don’t want to cheat and plant 2 trees, ya feel me?
